description: A multi-agent system for discovering, ranking, and explaining dataset recommendations.

architecture.internal_agent_communication: Python function calls and Pydantic models

agents.name: NLP agent
agents.role: Identify the query domain, task, and keywords.

agents.name: Discovery agent
agents.role: Retrieve semantically related datasets from the catalog.

agents.name: Dataset collection agent
agents.role: Collect external candidates from Kaggle, OpenML, and Hugging Face.

agents.name: Evaluation agent
agents.role: Rank dataset candidates and explain their relevance.

agents.name: Recommendation agent
agents.role: Suggest datasets using a signed-in user's search history.
